Messages.Author: Damnans
Messages.Body:
According to this recent news, the VTES ranking will be fully operational on the 5th of May:

www.vekn.net/index.php/forum/10-news-and-announcements/47142-state-of-the-vekn-news-from-the-printshop

> The team working on the new rating integration with Archon upload functionality has now fixed a date for public release, which will be Sunday May 5th. This will not only include the website functionality, but also a (required) new version of The Archon and some detailed use guidelines.
>
Note that if you click on  Player Rergistry , you will see a list of players sorted according to their current ranking. That's because a few National Coordinators have been testing the modules involved.

V:EKN Website Coordinator

The new system works so everyone uploads their Archons to vekn.net by themselves.

Easy, convenient and without any kind of bureaucracy.
